findings.passage: Against this backdrop, I would support voter ID laws that are not designed to suppress the right to vote and if the IDs are easily available and issued free of charge.
findings.note: Answer to a Franklin Observer online debate question on voter ID, posted on his campaign site.

findings.passage: I believe that the current Massachusetts law is adequate and see no basis for making further changes. If presented with evidence of voter fraud, however, I would push for changes.
findings.note: Closing of the same debate answer, after listing the ID that Massachusetts already may ask for at check-in.
